items.statement: The submission treats the two named XYZ geometries as the supplied acid (+2, singlet) and base (-2, singlet) systems and reports atom-count, provenance and convergence checks.
items.expected_result: Both named structures are separately validated with 62 and 58 atoms, charges +2 and -2, multiplicity 1, and calculation/convergence evidence.
items.expected: Both named structures are separately validated with 62 and 58 atoms, charges +2 and -2, multiplicity 1, and calculation/convergence evidence.

items.statement: The calculation reports four labeled low-lying singlet states for each structure and defines brightest-state selection from the same per-structure set.
items.expected_result: S1-S4 energies and oscillator strengths are retained for both objects and the selection rule is explicit.
items.expected: S1-S4 energies and oscillator strengths are retained for both objects and the selection rule is explicit.

items.statement: The acid four-state set contains a strongest transition at S3.
items.expected_result: The submitted acid brightest_state is S3 and its reported oscillator strength is the maximum of its acid S1-S4 values.
items.expected: The submitted acid brightest_state is S3 and its reported oscillator strength is the maximum of its acid S1-S4 values.

items.statement: The base four-state set contains a strongest transition at S1.
items.expected_result: The submitted base brightest_state is S1 and its reported oscillator strength is the maximum of its base S1-S4 values.
items.expected: The submitted base brightest_state is S1 and its reported oscillator strength is the maximum of its base S1-S4 values.
